maya: tiny design review 7: compact playground streaming control layout. user complaint: Stop is getting occluded by the token chip at narrow widths so they can't interrupt reliably. alex: repro'd on iPhone SE viewport. Stop gets pushed under the token pill when sender name wraps. jordan: idea: make Stop a fixed inline control on the left edge of the control row in compact mode, keep Regen on the right. Token count collapses to a micro-dot that expands on hover/focus. maya: yup. priority is making the interrupt affordance persistent. token visibility can be secondary. sam: accessibility: if token expands only on hover, keyboard and screen reader users lose it. expand on keyboard focus as well and ensure aria-label includes numeric value. also add aria-live on the stream container so assistive tech gets updates when streaming starts/stops. kevin: nice. microcopy tweak: prefer tooltip text "Interrupt generation (Esc)" so shortcut is discoverable. tagging @design-bot for final copy. design-bot: Copy options: - "Interrupt generation (Esc)" - "Stop generation" - "Cancel response" maya: i pick "Interrupt generation (Esc)" — explicit and surfaces the keybinding. alex: FE note: moving Stop left is trivial but watch for animation overlap with token meter expand. add a short debounce on meter expand to avoid layout jitter while streaming. jordan: suggestion for collapsed token: a bullet + number like " 76" that expands to a full bar on hover/focus; aria-label would read "Tokens used: 76". keeps width tiny. sam: sample aria snippet to include in spec: ```
Streaming
76 ``` kevin: product question: after Stop, do we leave partial text inline or show a subtle inline banner "Generation stopped partial response" with Retry? Banner should be announced via aria-live. maya: banner + Retry. avoids confusion about state. Retry should be same-row action and keyboard reachable. jordan: also capture analytics: interrupt stage (pre-first-token / mid / near-end) to see where folks stop. alex: regen button copy in compact rail is long. consider icon + "Regen" or icon-only with aria-label. sam: icon-only ok if focus ring is prominent and aria-name present. include keyboard tests in a11y checklist. kevin: QA checklist suggestion: - compact layout: stop-left regen-right at 320px - token counter reachable via keyboard and hover - aria-live messages for stream start/stop and for stop banner - Esc triggers stop and tooltip shows shortcut - analytics event for interrupt timing bucketed into early/mid/late maya: i'll put a small prototype together and link a PR. tagging @jordan @alex for FE/figma sync. anyone want to sketch alternatives here? jordan: dropping a quick figma 1-up by EOD with two variants: dot+number and icon-only token. alex: i'll implement debounce for token expand and verify no cache indicator overlap. sam: i'll add voiceover and keyboard test cases to the accessibility doc. kevin: nice, this should reduce user confusion a lot. :thumbsup: maya: thanks everyone will follow up with PR + screenshots.
